text:
Hundreds of motorcyclists dressed in superhero costumes rode through Buenos Aires, Argentina, to deliver toys to sick children for Children’s Day.

The event, which celebrated its 20th anniversary, was inspired by a similar initiative at a children’s hospital in Glasgow.
translated_text:

该活动庆祝其成立 20 周年，其灵感来自格拉斯哥一家儿童医院的类似举措。
